Really, this whole set is fantastic -- the magnifying glass is real glass and the pipe looks and feels like a real pipe. The deerstalker hat is the real star here, though. It's truly a top notch hat. The stitching and construction are excellent and it's got a nice fabric lining. The ear flaps can be left tied up in classic Sherlock fashion or you can untie them and let them hang down for ear warmth. It just looks amazing. I'm a petite female (about a 21" circumference head) and bought the size Small (recommended for kids). It's still a bit oversized on me. It's tricky to measure the inner circumference of the hat, but I tried and I came up with about 22 1/2". Alas, any hope of remaining humble vanished the moment I donned the hat and gripped the pipe. I now roam the house in full character, solving life’s greatest enigmas, from the perennial disappearance of single socks to the more existential mystery of why father never returned from that fateful milk run four years ago.The set is delightful. While the magnifying glass leaves a bit to be desired in terms of quality, the hat alone is worth the price. And, to my great relief, the large size fits my rather considerable cranium quite comfortably. Capital purchase—jolly good, indeed!
